components.name: PopoverWizard
components.description: Small multi-step panel anchored to its trigger. Use it for tours, quick setup and short forms that should not cover the page like a dialog.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The anchor. A string becomes an outline button.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title for steps that have none.

props.name: onBeforeNext
props.description: Runs before each advance. Return false to stay put.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Runs when Next is pressed on the last step. The popover then closes.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: One string, one per step as an array, or a function of the step index.

props.name: jumpFromDots
props.description: Lets a click on a dot jump to that step.

props.name: headerTrailing
props.description: Sits at the end of the header row, before the close button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Swaps the step body for a spinner.
